title: 33 Benefits of ERCA’s Compendium of Decisions
text:
Published On - December 28, 2022

A compilation of ERCA’s rulings on cases involving competition and consumer protection in the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) region is available in the form of the ECOWAS Regional Competition Authority (ERCA) Compendium of Decisions. It has the potential to greatly affect the business climate and overall economic development in West Africa and is therefore an essential resource. In this article, we will list the top 33 benefits of using the ERCA Compendium of Decisions:

Overall, the ERCA Compendium of Decisions is an important resource that has numerous advantages for businesses, competition practitioners, and other stakeholders in the ECOWAS region. Promoting transparency, consistency, and understanding of competition law and policy, helps to create a more favorable business environment and contributes to the economic development and prosperity of the region.
